estimate.name: Virtualitics ALZ Azure Government Planning Estimate
estimate.scenario: Azure Government Virginia landing zone aligned application estimate

defaults.provisioning_state: Median expected provisioned state for the proposal estimate period
defaults.data_sizing_policy: Use conservative high-end data volume assumptions until workload telemetry is available

retention_policy.basis: Planning assumption for audit and operational logs with NIST SP 800-53 context

assumptions.text: Azure Government Virginia is the default region for MVP sample estimates.
Public retail meters may not resolve all Azure Government services and must be reviewed by an Azure solution architect.
Manual overrides represent Azure consumption planning values only and are not customer agreement pricing.
AKS is the proposal baseline, with ARO retained as a decision option pending Microsoft confirmation.
Virtualitics confirmed one Kubernetes cluster per impact level is sufficient; DEV/STG/PRD are represented primarily as namespaces on production-grade AKS capacity.
Database, storage, cache, monitoring, backup, ingress, registry, and administrative services use lighter dev and test sizing than prod where service-specific optimization is practical.

line_items.name: AKS system node pool
line_items.sku_name: D4s v5 Linux VM planning placeholder
line_items.notes: One production-grade AKS system node pool per impact level, hosting dev/test/prod namespaces inside the IL boundary.

line_items.name: AKS user workload node pool
line_items.sku_name: D8s v5 Linux VM planning placeholder
line_items.notes: Production-grade AKS user node pool shared by dev/test/prod namespaces within each impact level.

line_items.name: Hot storage for application data

dimension_overrides.notes: Dev storage is reduced because it supports build and integration validation data only.
Test storage is sized above dev for representative QA data volumes.
Prod storage uses the conservative high-end application data assumption.

line_items.notes: Conservative high-end data estimate until customer sizing is confirmed.

line_items.name: PostgreSQL Flexible Server
line_items.service_name: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server

dimension_overrides.notes: Dev PostgreSQL uses the lightest compute tier for functional validation.
Test PostgreSQL uses mid-size compute for QA and integration validation.
Prod PostgreSQL uses the full planning tier pending customer workload telemetry.

line_items.notes: Source-backed planning placeholder for RDS PostgreSQL migration to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server.

line_items.name: MySQL Flexible Server
line_items.service_name: Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server

dimension_overrides.notes: Dev MySQL uses minimized compute for account-management dependency validation.
Test MySQL supports QA and integration account-management workloads.
Prod MySQL uses the full planning tier pending final dependency mapping.

line_items.notes: Source-backed planning placeholder for RDS MySQL migration to Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server where available; Azure Secret may require a replacement pattern.

line_items.name: Redis cache

dimension_overrides.notes: Dev cache is scaled down for functional smoke testing.
Test cache is sized between dev and prod for QA load.
Prod cache keeps the premium planning placeholder.

line_items.notes: Planning placeholder for Redis-compatible application dependency.

dimension_overrides.notes: Dev registry allocation is reduced for non-production image retention.
Test registry allocation supports promotion validation and QA images.
Prod keeps premium registry capacity for production image flow.
Dev Key Vault operations are reduced for lower traffic.
Test Key Vault operations are sized between dev and prod.
Prod uses the full operations placeholder.
Dev egress is reduced pending traffic profile confirmation.
Test egress assumes representative integration traffic.
Prod uses the full placeholder pending customer traffic profile.

line_items.name: Application Gateway ingress

dimension_overrides.notes: Dev ingress uses reduced shared capacity for validation traffic.
Test ingress is sized for QA traffic and promotion validation.
Prod keeps the full controlled ingress placeholder.

line_items.notes: Planning placeholder for controlled ingress into AKS-hosted workloads.

line_items.name: Log Analytics ingestion

dimension_overrides.notes: Dev logging is lighter because it captures lower-volume validation activity.
Test logging supports QA and integration evidence volumes.
Prod uses the full operational logging placeholder.

line_items.notes: Manual override pending final Gov meter selection.

line_items.name: Defender for Cloud plan

dimension_overrides.notes: Dev protected server count is reduced for lower non-production footprint.
Test protected server count supports QA footprint.
Prod uses the full server protection placeholder.

line_items.notes: Requires Microsoft confirmation for applicable Gov plan and meter.

line_items.name: Backup protected instances and storage

dimension_overrides.notes: Dev backup coverage is reduced for non-production recovery needs.
Test backup coverage supports QA and integration recovery needs.
Prod uses the full backup protected instance placeholder.

line_items.notes: Manual override includes backup planning assumption.

line_items.name: Bastion administrator access

dimension_overrides.notes: Dev administrative access is allocated as reduced shared capacity.
Test administrative access is allocated between dev and prod.
Prod keeps full Bastion access capacity.

line_items.notes: Administrator access path for planning estimate.

exclusions: AIS labor, O&M, support, implementation services, retainers, incident response, and proposal labor are excluded.
Customer agreement pricing, marketplace quotes, reserved instances, and savings plans are excluded from MVP totals.
Azure Government Secret availability and pricing require separate confirmation.
